@mrmickme2 @COVID19info101 Translation: "In addition to the two confirmed cases of metapneumovirus (HMPV), there are dozens of cases under surveillance, specifically in San Luis Potosi and Sinaloa.
In San Luis Potosi, there were reports that a child had died from metapneumovirus. "
